clips.title: The story
paras: Tyrande Whisperwind keeps watch over the night elves from Teldrassil. She is Elune’s High Priestess and the supreme leader of her people, who endured the War of the Ancients and the ten millennia of the Long Vigil under her guidance alongside Malfurion Stormrage. Now she commands the Sisterhood of Elune and directs the Sentinel army in Kalimdor’s defense.

Born in the ancient kaldorei empire, Tyrande grew up with the twin brothers Malfurion and Illidan Stormrage. The brothers turned to druidism and sorcery, while she became a priestess of Elune. When the Burning Legion first invaded Azeroth in the War of the Ancients, Tyrande stood against it beside Malfurion. The Moon Goddess granted her direct favor, and Tyrande shaped the Sisterhood into a fighting force. Her priestesses wielded divine healing and lunar wrath as the kaldorei faced annihilation.

After the Great Sundering and the sealing of the Well of Eternity, Malfurion and the druids entered the Emerald Dream for long hibernations. Tyrande took on the lonely task of defending their recovering realm. She formed the Sentinels, an elite cadre of warrior-women who patrolled Kalimdor’s forests through ten thousand years. During the Long Vigil, they kept watch over ancient evils and lingering demonic remnants. Tyrande held to her faith in Elune while centuries passed between brief reunions with Malfurion.

When the Burning Legion returned during the Third War, Tyrande woke the sleeping druids to face the danger. Though she mistrusted the newly arrived orcs and humans, she helped forge a desperate coalition at Mount Hyjal. The night elves gave up their immortality at Nordrassil to destroy Archimonde. Mount Hyjal now bears the scars of that battle, and Malfurion is again occupied with guarding the Emerald Dream. From the grand Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, Tyrande governs the kaldorei and watches for Horde incursions as her people take their place in the Alliance.
